The iPhone 18 Pro is set to be unveiled next week, and while most iPhone 17 Pro users won't upgrade that quickly, for those considering switching to a new device, there are three major features that might entice them to make the move.

#1: Significantly Improved Battery Life

Longer battery life is often the feature iPhone users look forward to most. Who wouldn't want an iPhone that lasts longer on a single charge?

Last year's iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max already saw major improvements in this area, but reports suggest Apple will further extend battery life this year.

The iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max are expected to benefit from multiple performance upgrades: an LTPO+ display, an A20 Pro chip built on a 2nm process, and possibly Apple's in-house C2 modem.

Beyond the above improvements, the latest reports indicate that this year's Pro models will feature larger physical battery capacities, particularly the iPhone 18 Pro Max.

#2: Major Camera Upgrades

According to Mark Gurman, the iPhone 18 Pro will bring "the biggest camera hardware leap in years."

Reports indicate that the main lens and telephoto lens will be the focus of Apple's upgrades this time—the former will feature a new variable aperture function, while the latter will come equipped with a larger aperture.

Weibo leaker Fixed Focus Digital also recently stated that due to an "enlarged main lens module," the camera bump on the iPhone 18 Pro will be 2mm thicker than last year's model. This is another hint that significant changes are on the way.

It would of course be even better to have more specific details at this point, but all signs indicate that Apple is preparing some particularly eye-catching camera upgrades.

#3: Design Innovation

Design matters a great deal for most users considering upgrading their iPhone year over year. If the new iPhone looks almost identical to your current model, the appeal of upgrading naturally diminishes significantly.

While Apple is not expected to dramatically change the look and feel of the iPhone 17 Pro, reports suggest the iPhone 18 Pro will receive three design updates:

  • Brand new color options
  • A smaller Dynamic Island
  • A unified back glass and aluminum design

Current reports point to deep cherry, light blue, and silver as the main colors, with the possible addition of black/space gray.

The iPhone 18 Pro's Dynamic Island is expected to shrink by approximately 35% compared to the previous generation, offering a more modern appearance and more usable screen space.

Finally, the much-debated two-tone back design from last year will be replaced with a more unified look on the iPhone 18 Pro.

Are you considering upgrading from the iPhone 17 Pro to the iPhone 18 Pro? Which factors matter most to you? Let us know in the comments section.
